taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Android backup/device-transfer rules for declared sensitive app data
controls.source_trace: Determine which files participate in actual backup and device transfer paths, separating platform versions and debug tooling.
controls.implementation_branch: Branch on Android version, cloud backup versus device-to-device transfer and the installed build rules. A single allowBackup value does not describe every transport/version. Determine whether the threat model grants backup extraction access and whether restored data remains useful under keystore/account binding, without collecting production app backups.
controls.operational_method: Resolve OS/target build and supported transport before selecting fullBackupContent or dataExtractionRules and its applicable cloud/device-transfer/cross-platform section. Missing rules in a supported mode can differ from an explicit exclusion; allowBackup=false is not a universal guarantee across OEM transfer paths. Retain the effective build rules and an owned synthetic backup/restore artifact for the selected mode. Do not infer current cross-platform behavior from an old two-transport fixture.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an emulator/test account and synthetic secret marker; inspect an owned supported backup or restored app without extracting real-user data.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A file in private app storage is not automatically excluded from every transfer; unsupported adb backup behavior cannot prove current platform exposure.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Exclude or protect sensitive persisted data under the actual backup modes and verify legitimate restoration.
